name: Entity Reference Deck Gin
description: Gin admin theme skin: remaps --erdeck-* tokens (hook_library_info_alter). Optional when the Gin admin theme is installed.
project_description: Skin submodule of Entity Reference Deck. Because core only honours libraries-extend from the active theme (not from modules), LibraryHooks::libraryInfoAlter() adds the 'entity_reference_deck_gin/gin_skin' library as a dependency of the deck card / dialog / EB widget / Paragraphs widget libraries so Gin-themed admin forms pick up --erdeck-* token remaps (selectors scoped to body.gin--edit-form). No routes, permissions, services or plugins; pure CSS token remap. Recommended with the Gin admin theme.
